snippet.title: Fortnite Galactic Battle Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
A galactic reckoning is coming… Heroes are ready to strike back against the assault led by Emperor Palpatine from the shadows, and the Island’s fate hangs in the balance. Draw your lightsaber and ready your blaster May 2 in Fortnite: GALACTIC BATTLE! https://fn.gg/GalacticBattle

Play Fortnite Battle Royale, the completely free 100-player PvP mode. One giant map, A Battle Bus, Last one standing wins. ESRB Rating: Teen with Violence.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fortnite/​
Twitter: https://twitter.com/FortniteGame​
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FortniteGame/​
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@Fortnite
